damage.does: Deal typed damage through the one damage pipeline (combat.md C63).

fields.type: phys | fire | ice | lightning | poison | dark | light | magic (default phys) | cycle (the next type of the owner cycleTypes list each time)
fields.tags: list of damage tags: attack, spell, proc, area, single-target, ranged, melee, periodic, environment, ground, reflected, arc
fields.premitigated: true skips creature rules, outgoing rules and defences (periodic ticks)
fields.bypassShields: true skips the player's absorb pools
fields.resistanceApplied: true when the amount already carries the resistance multiplier
fields.capPctMaxHp: on the player, never more than this % of max HP in one packet
fields.resist: true multiplies a pre-mitigated amount by the receiver's resistance to the type (status ticks)
fields.then: list of effects run once for each body this damage landed on
fields.minOnPlayer: on the player, at least this much after capPctMaxHp (1.7 trapDmg: max(2, min(raw, 25% max HP)))
fields.armourPierce: percent of the receiver's armour this packet ignores, 0-100 (spikes: 100)
fields.cycleTypes: with type cycle: the list of types in order

damage.visible: float the number in the type colour; hurt clip; player-hurt sound on the player; rider packets log 'Name → Target: N.'

weapon-attack.does: Make a full weapon strike with to-hit, crit, surprise, block and every on-hit rider (combat.md order of rolls).

fields.label: player-facing label for the log (Cleave, Riposte, Gust, Charge)
fields.weapon: main | offhand | ranged | the actor's own
fields.sureHit: true sets the hit chance to 1
fields.projected: true draws a projectile instead of a lunge
fields.then: list of effects run on each body the strike hits, as for damage (Lunge stun, Anvil's Toll push and stun)
fields.splitTo: selector: a second body struck for splitMult when it exists; the main strike is then also x splitMult (Prism Scarab)

weapon-attack.visible: lunge or arrow, swing or bow-shot sound, hit sound by armour, log 'Label: You hit Name: N.'

spell-strike.does: A spell hit on one body: crit, surprise and Numbing Dark rules, spell on-hit riders, grouped spell log.

fields.bolt: true for a single-target bolt (surprise before crit, rolls to hit)
fields.piercing: true: a bolt that is not single-target for riders
fields.sureHit: true: it never misses (Magic Missile; magic.md answer 3, 2026-10-16)

spell-strike.visible: cast clip, element cast sound, bolt or burst, log 'Spell: Name N (crit); Burning.'

damage-from-packet.does: Deal damage equal to a ratio of another packet: the one just dealt, taken, blocked or stored.

fields.packet: dealt | taken | taken-with-shields | blocked | stored | raw (the blow before armour, resistance and shields: Fire and Shadow weapon enchants)
fields.flat: a fixed amount instead of a ratio (Sentinel reflect)
fields.to: selector for the receiver (default: the other party of the packet)
fields.capPctMaxHp: on the player, never more than this % of max HP in one packet

damage-from-packet.visible: rider log and float as damage

heal.does: Restore HP through the one heal channel (Rot, Glimmer, Sanctuary apply; overflow is reported).

fields.natural: true for regeneration-like heals (does not stanch Bleed)
fields.regen: true: counts as regeneration (stopped entirely by Rot)
fields.overflow: what the overflow becomes: none | ice-armor

heal.visible: float '+N' in heal colour (not for regeneration or a concealed body); merged into the action's log as '+N HP'

heal-mod.does: Multiply healing a body receives when a condition holds (Rot, Glimmer, Sanctuary).
examples: Rot: regeneration x 0, other heals x 0.5 js/engine/damage.js:40-47

drain.does: Heal the source by a ratio of the damage it dealt.

fields.flat: fixed heal per hit instead of a ratio

drain.visible: a wisp off the struck body; heal float on the source

mana.does: Restore or drain mana; a drain may convert the drained mana into HP or damage.

fields.ratio: with convertTo heal-source: HP the source heals per mana drained
fields.damagePct: percent of the mana drained that also lands on the target as damage

pay-hp.does: Spend the actor's own HP as a cost; never a damage packet.

set-hp.does: Set HP outright: a value, a fraction of max, or a non-lethal floor.

shield.does: Add to a named absorb pool that soaks damage before HP.

fields.pool: ward | mana-ward | ice-armor | hide | tome-ward | guard | blood-ward | sporecoat | lens | bone-ward (one whole hit)
fields.cap: amount form for the pool's maximum
fields.turns: game turns the pool lasts (the buff that keeps it)
fields.onAbsorb: list of effects run with the absorbed amount (Mana Ward restores mana)
fields.atLeast: amount form: raise the pool to at least this, never lowering it (Thorns)

shield.visible: float '-N' in the pool's colour when it absorbs; 'Name broken.' when it empties

apply-status.does: Apply a status from data/statuses.json under the status rules (statuses.md S1-S21).

fields.magnitude: amount form stored on the status (Burn damage, Slow multiplier)
fields.bolt: looks only: a shot of this TRAIL type flies from the victim (on-kill) to the body it lands on (Wildfire js/engine/death-adapter.js:144)
fields.durationModifiers: false turns off Iron Constitution and Sylla
fields.bossControl: true keeps the boss 1-turn cap even with modifiers off
fields.scale: decimal stored on this status instance as its status-scale (default 1): 1.7 damageScale, e.g. Sporecaller poison 0.25 js/enemies/sporecaller.js:96, chaos patch poison 1.5 js/world/chaos/chaos-enemies.js:383, Venom Strike 1 js/engine/damage-adapter.js:372

apply-status.visible: the status's own sound; the status name appended to the hit's log line

add-stack.does: Add stacks to a stacking status; at a threshold it may turn into another status.

fields.n: stacks to add (0 only refreshes an existing stack)

add-stack.visible: the status icon's stack number; the new status's sound and float

remove-status.does: End statuses by id, by tag, or by a named list (a cleanse).
remove-status.visible: as the content says ('hiss', 'The bleeding stops.')

grant-immunity.does: Make a body immune to a status, a status tag or a damage type, for a time or while a condition holds.

fields.turns: game turns; absent means while the source lasts

grant-immunity.visible: float 'immune' when it stops something; 'Resisted Name.' for Unstoppable

modify-duration.does: A standing rule on how long statuses or buffs last for a bearer.

fields.pct: self-buffs: each buff gained is lengthened once by this percent, at least min turns
fields.statuses: limit to these ids or tags

teleport.does: Move a body instantly to a chosen tile.

fields.to: target-tile | random-safe | distance-band | explored | landmark | beside-target
fields.rules: list: visible, empty, walkable, no-adjacent-foe, same-region, not-in-boss-arena, ordinary-room (inside a room with no special: never a vault, toll room, hidden pocket or puzzle room; with to random-safe the whole floor is searched)
fields.from: the body distance-band is measured from (default the owner)
fields.fallback: a second to rule when the first finds no tile
fields.landmark: with to landmark: the landmark id (ritual-circle-farthest-from-player)

teleport.visible: blink effect at both ends; sight recomputed

knockback.does: Push a body away from the source; stops at walls and bodies.

fields.direction: away | given | wave (the direction of the wave-band selector that marked the tile) | random-8 (a uniform one of the 8 neighbours)

knockback.visible: knock-thud when the push is stopped; the player gets Resolve 200 units

pull.does: Move a body toward the source.

dash.does: Travel a clear straight line, then run effects at the end (charge, lunge, leap, hook to a wall).

fields.then: list of effects at the end
fields.onMiss: effects run on the owner when the run reaches no one

dash.visible: the move tween; telegraphed lanes for creatures

flee-step.does: Spend the body's action stepping away from a threat (or waste it if trapped).

fall.does: Drop a body to the next floor (or out of the fight), with damage.

fields.carry: true: a falling creature arrives on the next floor and waits there; without it the creature leaves the run. The player always lands on the next floor (world.md W49)

examples: Levitate ends over a chasm js/engine/turns.js:87

untargetable.does: Put a body in a state where it cannot be damaged (entombed, submerged, burrowed, buried) until it ends.
untargetable.visible: the state's art; float 'immune' on a hit

movement-mode.does: Change how a body moves for a time: float over chasms and water, ignore roots and floor traps, pass thin walls, free steps.

summon.does: Create one or more creatures on the player's side or the enemy's.

fields.placement: near-source | near-target | room | unseen-far | field-tiles (the tiles of the field this effect belongs to) | thrown-near-target (free tiles of the target 3x3 the owner has a line to) | last-crypt-death-spots | beside-random-mound
fields.stats: hp and damage amount forms (spell power, divine, rank)
fields.copyOf: victim: a copy of the creature that just died (Shades)
fields.ratio: share of the copied creature's HP and damage
fields.floorCap: maximum alive of this creature on the floor
fields.noRevive: true: the summoned body cannot rise again (risen)

summon.visible: sparkle at each spawn; 'N Name summoned.'

clone-self.does: Create an allied copy of the player from a snapshot of their stats.

transform.does: Replace a creature with another kind, keeping its place.

split.does: When hurt past a threshold, a creature halves its HP into a new copy beside it.

fields.child: monster id, or self (a copy of the same kind)
fields.whenHitAtFullHp: true: splits when a direct hit with a source lands on it at full HP (1.7 slimes); belowPctMaxHp is then not used
fields.minHp: the hit must leave at least this much HP
fields.noXp: true: the copy gives no XP

revive.does: Bring a dead body back after a delay unless something stops it.

fields.once: true: a body that rose cannot rise again
fields.warning: string id logged when the body falls
fields.log: string id logged when it rises

revive.visible: warning log ('Shambler reviving: smash or burn its corpse!'); rise log

field.does: Lay a timed or permanent ground or air effect on tiles that runs effects on whoever stands in it.

fields.field: fire | ice | root | holy | web | gas | spores | static | poison-trail | chaos-hazard | darkness | smoke (sight 1 tile both ways, counts as dark, surprise on foes that lost the hero; one per floor; magic.md answer 21)
fields.each: list of effects on each body inside, per tick
fields.permanent: true: no duration; the field stays until cleared (grave ooze)
fields.cap: at most this many live fields of this row on the floor; the oldest is dropped
fields.perSource: at most this many live fields from one source; a new one replaces the oldest
fields.overlap: each (default: every field covering the tile ticks, world.md answer 2) | strongest (only the strongest deals damage; a status it applies uses the longest turns among the covering fields)
fields.only: flammable: only tiles that can burn (tall grass, short grass, web ground, a burnable prop) get the field; fire on tall grass burns 5 game turns, every other burnable tile 3, whatever turns says (1.7 ignite); fire never lands on water
fields.shapeLimit: same-region: shape tiles outside the source's region (a chaos island) are dropped, as are chasm and portal tiles
fields.eachOnce: list of effects run once on each body, the first tick it stands inside

field.visible: the field's ground art; its tick logs ('Gas: N.', 'Static field: N.')

terrain.does: Change map tiles or place blocking props, for a time or for good.

fields.set: water | ice | wall-rock | pillar | open-door | ash | scorch | chasm | fire (sets the tile burning, combat fire rules) | mushrooms (spore growth: trampling it deals 2 poison) | extinguish (puts out burning tiles; Knowledge sigils, magic.md answer 19)
fields.perTile: true: the effect chance rolls once per tile

terrain.visible: burst at each tile; sight recomputed

telegraph.does: Mark tiles now and run effects on them after a delay, unless interrupted.

fields.then: list of effects on the marked tiles
fields.interruptedBy: list: damage-taken N, damage-taken-pct N (percent of the owner max HP), control, fear, target-leaves, owner-moves, owner-dead, owner-not-hunting
fields.warning: string id of the warning log
fields.gaps: pattern id: safe cells left out of the marked tiles (the pattern is packet F's; the Unmaker's safe pattern)
fields.minPlayerTurns: it lands only once at least this many paid player turns have passed since it was marked, as well as the delay
fields.onInterrupted: effects run on the owner when an interruptedBy case ends it
fields.landsIfOwnerControlled: true: lands even if the owner is stunned, frozen or afraid meanwhile
fields.stores: damage-taken-from-player: the telegraph sums what the player deals the owner while it is pending; then-effects read it as packet stored

telegraph.visible: marked tiles on the map; a warning log with priority; shake when it lands

rotation.does: Give a creature a fixed, repeating order of moves; each move has a condition and an effect list; a move whose condition fails is skipped or waits, as its row says; a phase change restarts the order.

fields.moves: list of {if, effects, onFail: skip | wait}
fields.restartOn: trigger that starts the order again (on-hp-threshold)
fields.order: list of move ids: the order tried on each action when the moves are not a cycle
fields.orderByPhase: object phase id to a list of move ids: the cycle for that phase

rotation.visible: the moves' own telegraphs and logs

choose.does: Pick one of several effect lists: by weight (one draw), or by the player from a picker window.

fields.options: list of {weight, effects}, or {label, effects} for a picker; any option may carry if and else: when its if fails, its else effects run instead (keeps 1.7 odds for Wobbles)
fields.by: weight | player | move-kind (the option whose label is the current move kind)

choose.visible: the picker window, or the chosen outcome's own feedback

create-item.does: Put an item on the floor.

fields.item: item kind or loot table id
fields.plusAdd: whole number added to the item's rolled plus
fields.plusCap: the plus never goes above this
fields.enchant: enchant id, or plane (the plane's element, weapons and armour only)

modify-stat.readByNote: item 288 (passives-read.test.mjs): the stats read outside the hero's derived numbers, and the module that reads each: armour-pierce per blow, spell-range and range for spells, trap-spot and search by the traps' phases, hunger-rate by upkeep, piety-gain by faith's devotion, hp-regen and mp-regen by regenGear
modify-stat.does: Change a derived stat by a flat amount or a percent while the source lasts.

fields.stat: armour | evasion | accuracy | crit | crit-mult | damage | damage-pct | max-hp | max-mp | speed | spell-power | divine | block | parry | stealth | range | light | hp-regen | mp-regen | hunger-rate | piety-gain | xp-gain | luck | armour-pierce | spell-range | trap-spot | search | gear-bonus | enchant-strength | upgrade-cap
fields.add: amount added (hp-regen and mp-regen: percent of max per game turn)
fields.min: floor on the per-tick amount of a regen stat
fields.statNotes: armour-pierce: armour ignored by the owner's weapon hits (Mace); spell-range: tiles added to spell range (Staff); trap-spot: percent chance per paid action to spot each unfound trap in sight (Keen Eyes, passive spotting); search: added to searching (Keen Eyes). Source: spec/items.md decided question 1; gear-bonus, enchant-strength, upgrade-cap: Vellum rank 5 and Anvil ranks 1 and 5 (rulings on packets A and E)

resist.does: Change the multiplier for a damage type on a body.

fields.absorb: ratio: damage of this type heals the body by ratio x the amount instead of hurting it (combat.md C56)

damage-mod.does: Multiply or reduce damage dealt or taken when a condition holds.

fields.morePct: amount: damage x (1 + this / 100) (Into the Dark)

cost-mod.does: Change what an action costs in mana, time or essence.

fields.for: spells | divine | tech | melee | unarmed | all

crit-rule.does: Force a critical hit when a condition holds, or make a body immune to crits.

hit-rule.does: Change to-hit for an attacker or defender: sure hit, a multiplier, ignored evasion, or a chance to deflect, parry or block.

fields.surprise: condition: a hit that meets it counts as a surprise hit (Numbing Dark on Chilled foes; magic.md answer 16, 2026-10-16)

action-economy.does: Grant free actions, an extra strike, instant casts or a reroll.

fields.free: chance for the action to cost no time
fields.reroll: failed combat rolls rerolled per action

action-economy.visible: 'Lucky Streak: reroll succeeded.' where 1.7 logs it

on-event.does: Run a list of effects when a trigger fires on the owner, if the chance and conditions pass.

fields.filters: object: filters the trigger row lists in its own 'filters' (on-kill: victimStatus, by: spell); a filter the trigger does not list is a load error
fields.every: whole number N: on-action and on-world-pulse only; the effects run on every Nth firing, counted per owner from its creation (plane hazard cadences)
fields.sharedBy: kind: the oncePer counter is shared by every creature of the owner kind on the floor (Storm Beetle arc)

gain.does: Add to or take from a non-HP resource.

fields.resource: piety | favor | amusement | essence | motes | xp | hunger | affinity | affinity-cap | amulet-charge | pummel | level (a whole level, progress kept; Wisdom, magic.md answer 23)
fields.element: for motes, affinity and its cap

gain.visible: the resource's float or log ('+N essence')

cooldown.does: Start, shorten or clear an ability or prayer cooldown.

reveal.does: Reveal map, traps, hidden doors, creatures or items in an area.
reveal.visible: trap spot effect; 'Your ring tingles: ...'; automap fills

fields.which: all | worn | one-chosen | sigils (the kinds of carried sigils) | all-sigils (every sigil kind; magic.md answer 20)

identify.visible: the item's real name; log line

hide.does: Make the player Hidden; optionally every hunting creature loses track.
hide.visible: 'Smoke: Hidden.' and similar; the hidden look on the hero

light-radius.does: Set or change the player's light radius, for a time or while its condition holds.

fields.turns: duration; absent: holds while the effect's if holds (plane sight)

alert.does: Wake creatures and point them at a place (noise, alarm, howl, call for help).

fields.skipHunting: true: a creature already hunting keeps its hunt; only the others turn toward the place (alarm trap, ruling 2026-09-28)

alert.visible: alarm sound; 'spots you!' as they turn

lose-track.does: Make creatures stop hunting and wander.
lose-track.visible: none beyond the creatures turning away

taunt.does: Make adjacent creatures attack this body first.

item-change.does: Change an item: upgrade, transmute, destroy, recycle into essence, lift a curse.
item-change.visible: the item window confirms; log line

loot-mod.does: Change drop chances or the table a source rolls on.

fields.chanceMult: amount form: multiplies the drop chance, applied after chancePct adds (Ring of Luck)

script.does: Run one named script. Ruled 2026-10-15: set pieces are verb lists first; this table starts empty and a packet adds a script only with Justin's yes.

fields.script: script id from the approved table (empty at packet B)

on-hit.does: The owner's primary weapon or single-target spell hit landed for over 0.
on-hit.filters: weapon | spell | melee | ranged | crit | surprise | single-target

on-swing.does: The owner starts a main-hand weapon attack, before it rolls, hit or miss (not the off hand, not a proc).

on-crit.does: The owner's primary hit was a critical.

on-surprise-hit.does: The owner's primary hit was a surprise.

on-damage-dealt.does: Any damage packet from the owner landed (filter by type and tags).

on-damaged.does: The owner took damage over 0 (filter by type, ranged, source side).

on-hit-by.does: A creature's attack hit the owner's target: the attacker's riders on what it hits (poisons, rots, snuffs, bleeds, fangs).

on-attacked.does: A creature attacked the owner, hit or miss, once per attacker per action.

on-block.does: The owner blocked a blow; carries the blocked amount.

on-melee-hit-taken.does: An adjacent attacker damaged the owner, measured including shields.

on-kill.does: A death credited to the owner's side (filter by the victim's statuses).

filters.victimStatus: status id or tag the victim carried
filters.by: spell: the killing packet came from a spell (Shadow tome)

on-death.does: The owner itself dies (death bursts, clouds, shards).

on-lethal.does: The owner would die; effects may keep it alive (once per floor).

on-cast.does: The owner cast a spell, prayer or invoke; the packet's tags carry its kind (spell, invoke, prayer), read with has-tag.

on-pay-mana.does: The owner paid mana; carries the amount.

on-status-applied.does: A status was applied to a body (filter by status id and by who applied it).

filters.applied: status id: only when this status took (the hero's on a foe; each Chill stack counts)

on-status-tick.does: A status ticked on its bearer in the world pulse.

on-status-expired.does: A status ran out on its bearer.

on-status-blocked.does: A status was refused by an immunity.

on-enter-tile.does: A body entered a tile (traps, fields, plates).

on-world-pulse.does: Once per game turn, in the world pulse.

on-action.does: Once per paid player action, after the creatures (the after-world phase).

on-quiet.does: The owner has gone N calm actions (no fighting, no noise).

on-heal.does: The owner was healed (any heal; filter natural: false leaves out natural healing such as holy ground's pulse).

filters.natural: false: not a natural heal (a bleed is stanched only by a real one)

on-absorb.does: A shield pool of the owner absorbed damage; carries the amount.

on-sight.does: The owner first sees the player or a body comes within a radius.

on-hp-threshold.does: The owner's HP fell below a percent (boss phases).

on-floor-enter.does: The player arrived on a new floor.

target.does: The chosen body or tile, in range, with line of sight or a bolt path.

source.does: The other party of the triggering event (the attacker, the killer, the applier).

radius.does: Tiles within N (square) of a centre.
radius.fields: centre: self | target | point; n; of: a selector whose bodies the adjacency is measured from (Storm Beetle arc); through: connected-water (only tiles reached through water from the centre); kind, family, flag filters

ring.does: Tiles between an inner and an outer distance.

square.does: An N x N block at a point (3 x 3 most often).

line.does: A straight line of N tiles; piercing passes through bodies. from: self (default) | target | point | a named site (a pylon); toward: target | point; within: a cell rule (arena) that cuts the line before its first cell outside it.

cone.does: A cone from the owner toward the target.

chain.does: Jumps from body to nearest body within a range, N times.

nearest.does: The N nearest matching bodies within a range.
nearest.fields: n, range; packet F filters: family, kind, notKind, notSelf, order (nearest | most-hurt | nearest-to-target | player-first), need (hurt | below-65-pct | hurt-or-unraged | hurt-or-uncoated | without-blood-ward | hunting-without-lens | hunting-without-bone-ward), visibleFromOwner

all-visible.does: Every matching body the player can see.

wall-across.does: A short wall of tiles across the line to the target.

room.does: Every tile of the owner's room.

roll.does: A uniform whole roll between two numbers (one draw).

pct-of.does: A percent of a stat: max-hp, hp, max-mp, mp, damage-dealt, damage-taken, blocked, absorbed, essence, mana-paid (the mana the triggering payment spent: Light tome), overheal (the healing past full of the triggering heal: Holy Water, magic.md answer 17). The pct may itself be an amount form.

from-status.does: The magnitude stored on a status (Burn's d); {"from-status": "turns"} is its remaining turns (Purging Flame, Radiant Roots; magic.md answer 15).

scaled.does: Any amount form, plus per-unit terms and multipliers from a closed list: spell-power, divine, rank, floor, level, affinity:<element>, attribute:<id> (points over 10), total-affinity, stacks, status-scale, number-scale, lethality. A per term is a number (per unit) or stepped, {"every": N, "add": A}: A for every whole N units (floor(floor / 3) is {"floor": {"every": 3, "add": 1}}). 1.7's sDMG is number-scale x lethality, rounded, at least 1. Scaling key ability-scale: the owner creature abilityScale (Underdark 1.25; monsters.md M8). Scaling key weapon-damage-sum: the owner's main-hand damage, min + max (Sap; magic.md answer 2).

has-status.does: The body carries a status by id or tag; {any: true} for any harmful status; {beforeThisHit: true} only counts statuses it had before the triggering hit.

action-was.does: The action that triggered this was of a kind: attack | cast | noisy | move (Lightning Reflexes; magic.md answer 13, 2026-10-16).

hp-below-pct.does: A body's HP (or MP) is below a percent of its max: {pct, body: self | target | source, stat: hp | mp}.

creature-flag.does: The body is undead, shadowy, living, flying, a boss, an elite, an object, a foe, awake, a spellcaster, or elemental; fumes (gas immune: Grave Beetle), ooze (grave ooze immune), sporeproof (spore immune), airborne (flying, or levitating: status levitate or wind-carry), plane-native (a plane's roster kind, its elite, the Heart of the Mountain's limbs and nodes; planes.md answer 2); hunting (state hunt); starter, retired, bone, grounded, darksight, gas-immune, tiny, heavy, spider, aquatic and the other flags of monsters.md

off-guard.does: The body is off guard (combat.md C18).

hit-was.does: The triggering hit was crit, surprise, melee, ranged, single-target, primary, or spell.

combo.does: The owner has two elements at the combo ranks.

affinity-at-least.does: The owner's affinity in an element is at least N.

rank-at-least.does: The owner's god rank is at least N.

standing-on.does: The body stands in water, in deep water, on a chasm, on lava, on holy ground, in a field, or on a flat prop by id ({"prop": "updraft-vent"}).

in-combat.does: The owner took damage within the last 500 time units (one rule for HP regeneration, Ice Armor and Guard; ruled 2026-10-15, character.md A44).

distance.does: Distance between the owner and the other party is within a range.

wielding.does: The owner wields a weapon kind (unarmed, dagger, mace, bow, spear, shield, orb, tome, wand, staff).

chance.does: A roll at a percent; the owner decides how it rolls (player: luck, others: plain).

from-source.does: A named number on the content row that granted this effect (a prayer's mana per HP, a creature's ward size).

tuning.does: The rule written in a row of data/tuning.json, by row id (Chill's slow).

damage-type.does: The triggering packet is of a damage type.

kill-side.does: The death was credited to: player (the player's side), self (the owner's own blow), own-summon (one of the owner's summons), or any.

any.does: At least one listed condition holds.

heal-kind.does: The triggering heal is regeneration, or is not.

field-target.does: selector for who or where the effect lands (default: the triggering body, or self)

field-chance.does: whole percent or amount; player-owned chances roll with luck (Lucky Streak may reroll), creature and world chances roll plain (ruled 2026-10-15)

field-only.does: player | creatures: the effect applies only to that kind of bearer; on the field verb, flammable limits the tiles (field row)

field-clock.does: game-turn | action: the unit of any count in this effect (game-turn is the default)

target-is.does: The effect's target is a creature, an anchor (a wall, closed door or solid prop the hero can haul to), the player, or an ally. Used for the Hook's two branches.

fed.does: The owner is not starving: hunger above 0 (Mending regenerates only while fed and not poisoned).

trigger-traps.does: Set off every trap the selector covers, as if stepped on, credited to the owner.
trigger-traps.visible: each trap's own animation, sound and log
examples: Tide amulet trips the room's traps js/equipment/amulets.js

trigger-trap.does: Fire one named trap kind at the target's tile, as if stepped on there.
trigger-trap.visible: that trap's animation, sound and log

repeat-sigil.does: Cast the last sigil used again at no cost.

fields.maxMotes: only sigils that cost at most this many motes
fields.never: list of sigil ids that cannot be repeated

amount-fields.does: Any numeric field of any verb (mult, ratio, deflectPct, pct, chancePct, turns, and the rest) takes an amount form, resolved when the effect is created.

on-craft.does: The owner crafted at the Forge: enchant, upgrade, carve or fuse. Carries the craft kind.
on-craft.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

on-spend.does: The owner spent a resource. Carries the resource and the amount.
on-spend.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

craft-was.does: The triggering craft was enchant, upgrade, carve or fuse (list allowed).
craft-was.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

own-summons.does: Every living ally the owner summoned.
own-summons.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

race-flag.does: The hero's race row carries this flag (noHolyRadiance: the Gloomling never takes the Holy Symbol's Light heal).

has-tag.does: The triggering damage packet carries a tag, or any tag of a list (periodic, burn, poison, spell, ...).
has-tag.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

foes-in-sight.does: At least {min} foes are in the owner's sight; notBoss: true leaves bosses out of the count.
foes-in-sight.src: Justin 2026-10-15, rulings on packets A and E (07dfb35)

shop.does: Open a vendor's stock window: items for essence, bought while within reach of the vendor or its stall.

fields.reach: tiles from the vendor or its stall (1)

shop.visible: the stock window; 'You need N essence.' when short (pickup-item sound on a sale)

escort.does: Make a freed body an ally that walks to a goal while the player is near, follows otherwise, and pays a reward on arrival.

fields.who: selector (default the body just freed or summoned)
fields.playerWithin: tiles: it walks to the goal only while the player is this close (3)
fields.arriveWithin: tiles from the goal that count as arrived (1)
fields.reward: loot table id dropped on arrival
fields.stats: {hpPct, armourPct, evasionPct}: share of its normal numbers
fields.name: display name pattern ('Escaping X')
fields.onArrive: list of effects when it arrives

escort.visible: the escort log on start; 'The escapee thanks you, leaves a reward and escapes.' on arrival

prop-break.does: Break props on tiles: each runs its own onBreak, or turns to ash.

fields.props: filter: explosive | fluid | breakable | burnable, or a list of prop ids
fields.result: break (default: the prop's own onBreak runs) | ash (the prop is removed and leaves ash ground)

prop-break.visible: the prop's break art and sound; a chained break lands 180 ms after the one that caused it

travel.does: Move the hero (and what follows) to another floor or plane: the host floor is stashed and the destination built.

fields.to: plane | return (back to the host floor) | next-floor
fields.plane: plane element id, or portal (the element of the portal used)
fields.arrival: entry cell rule of the destination

travel.visible: the destination's arrival log, sound and shake

on-interact.does: The player used the owner prop (bump or the use key): cages, altars, bells, levers, crystals. Costs the player's action.

on-chest-open.does: A chest of the owner room is being opened; the effects run first and the chest opens after them only if the opener is still beside it.

filters.nth: which chest of the room this is: 1 the first opened, 2 the second

on-prop-broken.does: The owner prop was broken (a blow, a blast or fire). Carries the breaker.

adjacent-terrain.does: A tile beside the body (or the tested tile) is that terrain, or holds a prop whose id contains one of the given words: {terrain: lava | water | chasm | ..., prop: [words], ways: 4 | 8}.

lit-by.does: The body (or tile) is within N tiles (Chebyshev, fractional light positions) of a light of that kind: {light: plane | any, within: N}.

burned-within.does: The body took fire damage or carried Burn within the last N game turns: {turns: N}.

clear-path.does: Every cell of the straight path from a point to the body passes a cell rule: {from: source | point | a named site, cells: arena | walkable}.

blotch.does: K rectangles near a centre, each at the centre plus a uniform jitter, each cell kept by chance; duplicates drop out.
blotch.fields: count, centre, jitter [dx, dy], size [w, h], cellPct, ownCellPct (the centre's own tile), exclude (a cell condition), walkable

wave-band.does: A band across a uniform one of 4 directions through a centre, offset by a uniform step; its direction is the wave direction for knockback.

on-item-dropped.does: The player dropped an item in the owner room (or beside the owner).

near-feature.does: The body (or tested tile) is within N of a map feature: {features: [stairs, upstairs, exit, portal, forge, shrine], within: N}.

room-aisle.does: The tested tile is on a storage room's aisle (its lanes and hub, world.md S2).

field-cooldown.does: game turns before this effect can run again for the same owner (Goblin Brute shoulder check 4, Grave Beetle fumes 2)

field-uses.does: how many times this effect may run in the owner life (Stalker ambush 1, Tide Crab shell 3)

has-mana.does: The body has at least {atLeast} mana: {body: self | target, atLeast: N}.

sees.does: The owner sees the other party now (monsters.md M11): line of sight, not Hidden, not Blind.

in-state.does: The body is in a state: {state: asleep | wander | hunt | throne | dormant | submerged | burrowed | entombed | buried}.

every-nth-action.does: The owner action counter since waking is a multiple of n plus remainder: {n, remainder (default 0)}.

boss-alive.does: The set piece boss is alive or returning: {set: id}.

linked-alive.does: At least one body linked to the owner lives: {link: heart-nodes | own-summons}.

dismiss.does: Remove bodies from the map with no death: no death log, no drops, no XP, no kill credit, no death effects; each leaves with a small burst.

fields.who: selector for the bodies (own-summons most often)
fields.alsoClears: list: their fields and hazards, warnings, pylons
fields.keep: bodies the selector would take that stay (the player's Shades)

dismiss.visible: a small burst where each body was
examples: the Maw's brood sinks into the burrows js/engine/death-adapter.js:30-34
a summon's life runs out js/engine/turns.js:66-71
